description:
FILED s517a (Opus, 2026-10-15) -- a REAL CPAN cause line for the s331 ruling
"like/unlike with a plain STRING pattern follows test.pl (interpolate), both
callers -- accepted divergence; revisit on a real CPAN cause line"
(DECIDED, fable-answers-s331.md §3).  This is that line.

HTTP-Tiny-0.090 t/100_get.t:91 (and the other corpus-driven files):
    like( $text, "/".$case->{expected_like}[0]."/", $msg );
Test::More (Test::Builder::maybe_regex) reads a string of the form '/re/' (or
'm{re}flags') AS A REGEX.  PCL's TAP layer interpolates the whole string as a
pattern, so the slashes must match literally and the row fails:

    100_get.t (after #3262, s517a): PLAN 186, 4 rows fail -- 64 get-08.txt,
    128 get-16.txt, 136 get-17.txt, 177 get-22.txt -- each `got 'Size of
    response body exceeds ...' to match: /Size of response body exceeds .../`

Fix belongs in cl/pcl-test.lisp's like/unlike for the Test::More caller
(test.pl's own `like` keeps its interpolation -- the two callers differ in
perl too); it needs the ruling revisited first (a harness change: the
companion --all --quick and the sweep both reach it).
subject: like with a /re/ STRING pattern: Test::More reads it as a regex, the PCL TAP layer interpolates it (the s331 ruling real CPAN cause line: HTTP-Tiny corpus files)
